task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 is in stock, then place a hold for 1 unit for my account and confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice for 1 unit and send it to buyer@example.com with PayPal, then also check the latest business news, get the current New York weather and any weather alert card there, archive that alert as a medium-priority email note titled “Post-purchase weather archive” for my account, and finally create a document titled “Order and invoice audit note” tagged shopping, invoice, and weather.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 in the electronics category is in stock for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. If it is, place a hold for 1 unit for my account user_123 and confirm the order. The item list is: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. After that, generate an invoice for 1 unit and send it to buyer@example.com using paypal. Then check the latest business news, get the current weather in New York, and include any weather alert card there. Please archive that alert as a medium-priority email note for my account user_123 with the title “Post-purchase weather archive.” Finally, create a document titled “Order and invoice audit note” and tag it with shopping, invoice, and weather.
